5.translation: The sun and the moon follow their precise courses,

6.translation: and the stars[1] and trees prostrate [to Allah][2].
6.footnotes:
[1] "Najm" is also a vegetation without a trunk, stalk, or stem.
 [2] i.e., they obediently submit to the laws of Allah. See 22:18.

7.translation: He raised the heaven and enjoined justice

8.translation: so that you may not transgress the limits of justice.

9.translation: Therefore establish weights in justice, and do not give short measure.

10.translation: He has spread out the earth for all creatures,

11.translation: in which there are fruits and palm trees with date stalks,

12.translation: and grain having chaff, and fragrant plants.

13.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you[3] deny?

14.translation: He created man from dry clay like pottery,

15.translation: and He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

16.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

17.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets[4].
17.footnotes: [4] i.e., the points of sunrise in the east and sunset in the west in both summer and winter.

18.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

19.translation: He merges the two seas meeting together[5],
19.footnotes: [5] Two bodies of water or two sea waters of fresh and salty water.

20.translation: yet between them is a barrier so that they do not cross[6].

21.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

22.translation: Out of both of them emerge pearls and coral.

23.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

24.translation: To Him belong the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.

25.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

27.translation: but there will remain the Face of your Lord[7], full of Majesty and Honor.

28.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

29.translation: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[8].
29.footnotes: [8] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.

30.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

31.translation: We will attend to you, O two multitudes [of men and jinn].

32.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

33.translation: O assembly of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the realms of the heavens and earth, then pass; you cannot pass without [Our] authority.

34.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

35.translation: There will be sent against you a flame of fire and smoke[9], and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
35.footnotes: [9] It could also mean liquefied brass or copper.

36.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

37.translation: When the heaven is split asunder and becomes crimson like [burnt] oil[10].
37.footnotes: [10] Or like tanned skin or molten brass.

38.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

39.translation: On that Day no human or jinn will be asked about his sin[11].
39.footnotes: [11] For Allah knows their sins; they will only be interrogated as a form of punishment.

40.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

41.translation: The wicked will be known by their marks and will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

42.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

43.translation: [They will be told] “This is the Hell that the wicked used to deny.”

44.translation: They will go round between it and scalding water.

45.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny[12]?
45.footnotes: [12] Warning of the punishment in Hell is listed here as a favor as a reminder that the believers should be cautious of it and be saved of it on the Day of Judgment.

46.translation: For those who fear of standing before their Lord[13] will be two Gardens.

47.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

49.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

50.translation: In each there are two flowing springs.

51.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

52.translation: In each there are two kinds of every fruit.

53.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

54.translation: They will recline on couches lined with rich brocade, with the fruits of both gardens within reach.

55.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

56.translation: In them there will be maidens of restrained gaze[14], untouched[15] before them by any man or jinn.
56.footnotes:
[14] To their own mates, being chaste and modest.
 [15] Lit., the maidens have not been caused to bleed by loss of virginity.

57.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

58.translation: As if they were rubies and pearls[16].

59.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

60.translation: Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

61.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

62.translation: And besides these two there will be two other gardens.

63.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

65.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

66.translation: In each there are two gushing springs.

67.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

68.translation: In each there are fruits, palm trees, and pomegranates.

69.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

70.translation: In them there are beautiful noble women.

71.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

72.translation: Maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.

73.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

74.translation: No human or jinn has ever touched them before.

75.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

76.translation: [They will be] reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

77.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?

78.translation: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Honor.
